summary: Surgery with necks and extinction at interface level. SurgeryProcedureData consumes the D7 canonical-neighborhood certificate (the neck alternative) and extends the accepted D3 surgery ledger (SurgeryDatum / SurgeryCertificate / SurgeryChain) by the certified neck region, the neck identification, the surgery time and the curvature threshold; ProcedureChain forgets to the D3 chain and carries its ChainCertificate, so the D3 preservation theorems apply verbatim. Kernel-checked: a surgery-time schedule with a uniform gap is strictly increasing, has gap d between distinct times, at most one time in any interval of length d, an isolated neighbourhood at every time, is discrete and closed with empty derived set (no accumulation point), and has only finitely many times in any bounded interval; under the stated CurvatureBoundInterface (opaque curvature bound plus opaque maximum-principle estimate) these conclusions hold for the surgery times of a procedure family. Extinction for the finite toy complexity relation reuses the D3 ToyRel results: no infinite strictly decreasing natural sequence, no infinite ToyRel chain, constructive toy extinction ToyChain m 1 (m-1) for every positive m, uniqueness of the extinction time and the bound k <= m. State-only Props with named missing inputs: missingFullNeckAnalysis, missingAPrioriCurvatureEstimates, missingExtinctionTheorem and the combined missingSurgeryFlowTheorem, plus a 12-entry dependency ledger and 6 named blockers. No sorry/axiom/unsafe/native_decide/proof_wanted; all 107 audited declarations have standard axiom cones.

honest_boundary: The full Perelman neck analysis is not proved: the existence of a high-curvature neck, its separability in the simply connected case, and the admissibility of the cut-and-cap are opaque Props (missingFullNeckAnalysis).

The a-priori curvature estimates are not proved: CurvatureBoundInterface carries the curvature bound and the maximum-principle estimate as opaque Prop fields; only the metric/order-theoretic consequences of the resulting uniform gap are kernel-checked.

The geometric extinction theorem is not proved: ExtinctionData carries extinct and terminalSphere as opaque Props and the two geometric implications as fields; only the finiteness skeleton is checked.
The canonical-neighborhood certificate consumed by SurgeryProcedureData is the accepted D7 metric-shadow interface, not a smooth manifold-level neck.
The concrete inhabitant realLineProcedure uses the D7 line-cylinder metric model, not the smooth round cylinder S^2 x R.
The D3 toy relation ToyRel is a finite-component-count model; its extinction is the order-theoretic skeleton, not the geometric flow.
